premises.text: Peers learn significantly more from each other than from traditional educational content.
premises.evidence_span: Studies show that peers learn seven times more from each other than they do from any video content, anything hands down from the professors.

premises.text: Most educational technology is designed for top-down learning.
premises.evidence_span: Yet, 99% of all educational technology is built for top-down.

premises.text: Study Hall connects students for peer-to-peer learning.
premises.evidence_span: Study Hall is the smartest platform to connect with your classmates and make your academic life easier.

premises.text: An algorithm can recommend study partners based on user profiles.
premises.evidence_span: We've actually built the first algorithm in the world that recommends people with whom you should study.

premises.text: Students can post questions and receive help from classmates and professors in a secure environment.
